version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "npm"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10
    ignore:
      # TypeScript stays on 6.x until Astro supports 7. TS 7 dropped the
      # programmatic API `astro check` builds on, so a major bump turns the
      # type-check job red on arrival and there is nothing to fix on our side.
      # Minor and patch releases still come through. Drop this entry once
      # Astro ships TS 7 support.
      - dependency-name: "typescript"
        update-types: ["version-update:semver-major"]
    # Optional: Groups updates to reduce noise
    groups:
      astro-ecosystem:
        patterns:
          - "astro"
          - "@astrojs/*"
      icons:
        patterns:
          - "@iconify-json/*"

  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
    open-pull-requests-limit: 5

# Dependabot configuration — gitlab-mcp-server
# Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference
#
# Every ecosystem states its own cooldown. GitHub has applied a three-day
# default since July 2026, but a default is a property of the platform, not of
# this repository: it can be changed, and an absent key would then mean
# something different without anything here changing. A week is long enough for
# a compromised release to be yanked (the September 2025 npm maintainer
# phishing that hit `debug`, `chalk` and 16 other packages was caught in
# hours), and security updates ignore cooldown entirely, so this delays
# convenience, not fixes.
#
# Two deliberate omissions:
#   * docker-compose carries no cooldown — its images are :latest test fixtures
#     that generate no pull request. SemVer sub-keys are also left off the
#     docker entries: Dependabot scopes them to SemVer-aware managers and
#     rejects the whole configuration otherwise, which would stop that
#     ecosystem's updates completely.
#   * npm/gitlab-mcp-server, the published launcher, has no entry on purpose.
#     Its only dependencies are the per-platform packages, pinned to the exact
#     release version by scripts/update-server-json-sha.sh; a Dependabot bump
#     there would fight the release stamp and desynchronise the launcher from
#     the binaries it resolves.

version: 2

updates:
  # Go modules (root go.mod)
  - package-ecosystem: "gomod"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "monday"
      timezone: "Europe/Madrid"
    cooldown:
      default-days: 7
      semver-minor-days: 14
      semver-major-days: 30
    commit-message:
      prefix: "chore"
      include: "scope"
    labels:
      - "dependencies"
      - "go"
    groups:
      go-minor-patch:
        applies-to: version-updates
        update-types:
          - "minor"
          - "patch"
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10

  # pnpm / Astro docs site (site/package.json)
  - package-ecosystem: "npm"
    directory: "/site"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "monday"
      timezone: "Europe/Madrid"
    cooldown:
      default-days: 7
      semver-minor-days: 14
      semver-major-days: 30
    commit-message:
      prefix: "chore"
      include: "scope"
    labels:
      - "dependencies"
      - "javascript"
    groups:
      npm-minor-patch:
        applies-to: version-updates
        update-types:
          - "minor"
          - "patch"
    open-pull-requests-limit: 5

  # GitHub Actions workflows
  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "monday"
      timezone: "Europe/Madrid"
    # No SemVer sub-keys: an action pin is a commit SHA with a version comment,
    # and the cooldown that matters is the flat one before a hijacked tag is
    # adopted.
    cooldown:
      default-days: 7
    commit-message:
      prefix: "chore"
      include: "scope"
    labels:
      - "dependencies"
      - "github-actions"
    groups:
      actions-all:
        applies-to: version-updates
        patterns:
          - "*"

  # Docker (root Dockerfile)
  - package-ecosystem: "docker"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "monday"
      timezone: "Europe/Madrid"
    cooldown:
      default-days: 7
    commit-message:
      prefix: "chore"
      include: "scope"
    labels:
      - "dependencies"
      - "docker"

  # Docker Compose
  - package-ecosystem: "docker-compose"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "monday"
      timezone: "Europe/Madrid"
    commit-message:
      prefix: "chore"
      include: "scope"
    labels:
      - "dependencies"
      - "docker"

# CODEOWNERS — gitlab-mcp-server
#
# GitHub uses this file to automatically request reviews from code owners.
# Each line maps a file pattern to one or more owners. The last matching
# pattern takes precedence.
#
# Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/about-code-owners

# Default owner for everything
* @jmrplens

# Go source code
*.go @jmrplens
go.mod @jmrplens
go.sum @jmrplens

# Build
Makefile @jmrplens
scripts/ @jmrplens

# Documentation

internal/resources/ @jmrplens
